summary: Frontend-only retest of the iteration_141 a11y items (preview, parent1). Each check ran in both Playwright mobile emulation (is_mobile) and desktop-layout mode at 390@200% root font, 320@100%, and 320@200%; 195px is for information only. PASSED: guided modal focus return (keyboard Enter on court-module-foundation, Esc returns focus to court-module-foundation; Tab/Shift+Tab stay inside the modal; axe 0); BIFF drawer focus return to nav-biff; CB overlay focus return to door-comm; CB 320@100% (quick exit on screen, no scroll, brand wraps normally, no draft-card overflow); /register 390@200% and 320@100% have no horizontal scroll; /login 390@200% and 320@100% OK; login-hide-email-toggle is 25px tall and login-forgot-password-link 24px; 'AI found no friction cues' is emerald-800 (rgb 6,95,70); no ADVOCATE tag; axe reports 0 violations on /register, /login (email form open), the BIFF drawer before and after a real AI suggestion, the CB overlay and the guided modal; sonner toasts stay inside the viewport at 390@200% and 320. FAILED: portal home at 390@200% still scrolls sideways (scrollWidth 422 vs 390). The door cards' text spills out of its boxes, and the portal header brand is cut down to one letter 'S'. Because of this, on a real phone (mobile emulation) the layout viewport grows to 422px and the CB overlay grows with it. Separately, CB at 390@200% scrolls sideways by itself (417 vs 390): the AiInsightPanel 'Live' pill overflows. The quick exit is on screen (l=160, r=325).

ui_bugs.issue: At 390@200% the text overflows its box ('Communication Builder' text right edge 422 vs box right 248; 'Court Ordered' 336 vs 247), which makes the whole document 422px wide. Cause: the rem-based p-4, the w-12/w-10 icon box, gap-3 and the chevron all double at 200%, so the flex-1 text column is only about 60px wide and a single word cannot fit. At 320@200% the text overlaps the chevron and is clipped (see /app/tests/i142_doorcomm_320_200.jpeg).

ui_bugs.component: Portal header brand (SacoparentsPortal header: 'flex items-center space-x-2.5 min-w-0' with truncate children)
ui_bugs.issue: At 390@200% the 'sacoparentsapp.online' / 'SA CoParents Assessment & Alignment Portal' brand box is only 38px wide, so it is cut to 'S' and is hidden behind the Export PDF button. This is a loss of content (WCAG 1.4.4/1.4.10).

ui_bugs.component: AiInsightPanel header (selfAssessment/AiInsightPanel.jsx:108-120), shown inside the CB overlay
ui_bugs.issue: The header row is justify-between with no flex-wrap, so at 390@200% the 'Live' pill reaches r=417 and the CB overlay scrolls sideways (417 vs 390). At 320@200% the cb-ba-yours, add-milestone-btn and sa-ai-submit buttons also overflow.

Item labels are wider than their buttons: at 390@200% nav-doors 'Journey' is 67px in a 65px button; at 320@200% Journey, Report and PDF Export are 55-60px in 51px buttons, so neighbouring labels touch. Nothing is clipped off-screen in desktop mode, so this is minor.

issues: The fixed crisis strip, bottom nav and a sonner toast together cover about 230px of the 844px screen, and the toast sits on top of the bottom nav. Check that focused elements are not hidden behind them (WCAG 2.4.11).
The 'Tool for either path' chip (WelcomeArtwork.jsx:52) now uses rem but is text-[0.4375rem], which is 7px at 100%. It is aria-hidden, but sighted users can barely read it.
At 320@200% the wand icon on the CB 'Powered by Emergent AI' card spills over the card edge.

design_issues.screen: /register and /login at 320@200% (beyond the pass bar, for information)
issues: /register: the consent label span reaches r=325 (5px of scroll).
/login: the 'SA CoParents' text-3xl brand and the card-soft p-8 card push the page to 343px.
At 195px, /register's custody and mediation-date inputs reach r=206.

action_items: HIGH: JourneyShell.jsx door buttons (lines ~1046-1098): let the text column wrap long words (add break-words/hyphens-auto to the title and p), and at large text stack the icon above the text or shrink the icon box and padding. Goal: no horizontal scroll on portal home at 390@200%. This is also what widens the CB overlay on real phones.
Portal header: let the brand row wrap under or above the Export PDF button instead of truncating to 'S' at 200%. Remove truncate or add flex-wrap to the header row.
AiInsightPanel.jsx:108: add flex-wrap gap-2 to the header row and min-w-0 to the title block, so the 'Live' pill wraps and the CB overlay has no sideways scroll at 390@200%.

Optional: bottom-nav labels: add break-words or a smaller label size, or hide icons at large text. Raise 'Tool for either path' to at least 0.5625rem. Keep the sonner toast above the bottom nav and crisis strip on portal home, as is already done for #court-page.
critical_code_review_comments: The pattern of rem-based fixed icon boxes and paddings next to flex-1 text without break-words fails at 200% text in several places (door cards, AiInsightPanel header, CB buttons). Rather than patching each one, add a shared utility (e.g. [overflow-wrap:anywhere] on card text).

The guided-resume-discard-{topic} button uses text-slate-600 and min-h-6 (checked in code at GuidedJourneyModal.jsx:567). The resume prompt could not be triggered at runtime, so its contrast was not measured with axe.

success_rate.frontend: ~80% (16 of 20 targeted checks pass; portal home 390@200%, CB 390@200% and the portal header brand fail; bottom-nav label overlap is minor)

seed_data_creation: One guided foundation chat message 'TEST_resume draft text' sent for parent1; BIFF suggestion requests made.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run python /app/tests/a11y_retest142.py parent1@test.com 'TestPass123!' desktop (and again with 'mobile'). Desktop mode isolates each overlay's own overflow. Mobile mode reproduces the real phone layout-viewport growth, where an overflowing portal home also widens the fixed CB overlay. Use a11y_textnode_scan142.py to find text-node overflow, because element-rect culprit scans miss text spilling out of flex children. The '/' route remembers the last view (court page), so tests must handle door-court not being visible after visiting court. The guided resume prompt testid is guided-resume-discard-{topic}; it could not be triggered by sending one message and reopening. Pass bar used: 390@200% and 320@100%; 320@200% and 195px are for information.
rca of the issue: Portal home at 200%: the door buttons are flex rows with rem-sized p-4, a w-12 h-12 icon, gap-3 and a chevron. At 200% these take about 190px of the 254px card, leaving roughly 60px for text, and 'Communication' at 28px bold is about 200px wide, so the text overflows and sets scrollWidth to 422. In mobile browsers this widens the layout viewport, so the fixed CB overlay (inset-0) also becomes 422px wide. Inside CB, AiInsightPanel's non-wrapping justify-between header pushes the 'Live' pill to 417px.
